stories.title: Caen 5 por trasladar en yates a 45 mexicanos rumbo a EU

en.title: 5 arrested for transporting 45 Mexicans by yacht toward US
en.summary: Mexican navy intercepted two yachts carrying 45 Mexicans off Ensenada, Baja California, arresting five people and seizing approximately 1,850 liters of diesel fuel.

en.title: MND Tutor | Mexico's population
en.summary: Mexico's population exceeds 130 million people, though growth rates are slowing and fertility rates are declining significantly, fundamentally transforming the nation's demographic composition.

stories.title: 3 ideas que todavía frenan a los mexicanos para invertir, pese a que tienen más acceso

en.title: 3 ideas that still prevent Mexicans from investing, despite having greater access
en.summary: While opening investment accounts has become easier, persistent misconceptions about stock market participation remain common. Experts identify lack of financial education and guidance as primary barriers.

stories.title: ¿Qué debes saber antes de adoptar una mascota?; haz sentir cómodo a tu lomito o michi con estos consejos

en.title: What you should know before adopting a pet; make your furry friend comfortable with these tips
en.summary: Responsible pet adoption requires evaluating available time, budget, and living space to ensure the animal's wellbeing.

stories.title: Amazon remata sus perfumes masculinos más vendidos; Náutica Voyage y Blue Sail alcanzan hasta 49% de descuento

en.title: Amazon clears out its best-selling men's perfumes; Nautica Voyage and Blue Sail reach up to 49% discount
en.summary: Amazon is offering significant discounts on popular men's fragrances Nautica Voyage and Blue Sail, promoting their freshness and lasting power.

stories.title: Amnistía Internacional exige que el Ejército proporcione información sobre los 43 de Ayotzinapa

en.title: Amnesty International demands that the Army provide information about the 43 of Ayotzinapa
en.summary: Amnesty International is calling for the Mexican military to release information regarding the 43 disappeared students from Ayotzinapa, with video evidence deletion attributed to former governor Ángel Aguirre Rivero and two others.

stories.title: Una multitud marcha en Madrid contra el desalojo de una mujer de 87 años; exigen frenar el costo de la vivienda en España

en.title: A crowd marches in Madrid against the eviction of an 87-year-old woman; they demand a halt to housing costs in Spain
en.summary: A large crowd demonstrated in Madrid to protest the eviction of an elderly woman while calling for measures to address rising housing costs across Spain.

stories.title: Huracán Polo baja a categoría 4; Gobierno llama a extremar medidas de prevención

en.title: Hurricane Polo drops to category 4; Government calls for heightening prevention measures
en.summary: Hurricane Polo has weakened to category 4 status, with the Mexican government urging increased precautions ahead of impacts expected in Baja California Sur on Monday and Sonora on Tuesday.

stories.title: Amnistía acusa al Ejército de no entregar información del caso Ayotzinapa; "la transparencia tiene un peso fundamental", considera

en.title: Amnesty accuses Army of not delivering information in Ayotzinapa case; "transparency has fundamental importance", it considers
en.summary: Amnesty International states that the Mexican Army has failed to provide documents in the Ayotzinapa case despite a court order requiring disclosure.

stories.title: “Polo” se debilita a categoría 4 frente a Baja California Sur; sigue en vivo su desplazamiento

en.title: "Polo" weakens to category 4 hurricane off Baja California Sur; tracking its movement
en.summary: Hurricane Polo has downgraded to category 4 strength as it approaches Baja California Sur, with authorities monitoring its path.

stories.title: Huracán Polo se intensifica nuevamente a categoría 5

en.title: Hurricane Polo intensifies again to category 5
en.summary: Hurricane Polo strengthened to category 5 while moving parallel to Mexico's Pacific coast toward Baja California Sur, where forecasters predict it could make landfall as a category 1 or 2 storm early next week.

stories.title: España: octogenaria en desahucio insta a luchar contra crisis de vivienda

en.title: Spain: elderly woman facing eviction urges fight against housing crisis
en.summary: An 80-year-old Spanish woman evicted from her home by a vulture fund called for others to fight the country's housing crisis during her hospital recovery.

stories.title: Tupperware encara el reto de llegar a nuevas generaciones con sus tradicionales ventas por catálogo

en.title: Tupperware faces challenge of reaching new generations with its traditional catalog sales
en.summary: Tupperware, which previously aimed to expand into physical retail spaces like supermarkets, is adjusting its strategy following its bankruptcy restructuring process.

stories.title: México envejeció en cinco años y la presión por pagar pensiones apenas comienza

en.title: Mexico aged in five years and pressure to pay pensions is just beginning
en.summary: Mexico's population has aged significantly, with one in six households already receiving pensions. Public spending on pensions is projected to reach 2.5 trillion pesos by 2027.

stories.title: Trump rechaza el plan iraní para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz

en.title: Trump rejects Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz within seven days following approval of an agreement, but Trump rejected the proposal.

stories.title: Se debe romper el mito de que bancarizar es fiscalizar, dice la CNBV; defiende Ley de Economía Digital

en.title: Myth that banking is surveillance must be broken, says CNBV; defends Digital Economy Law
en.summary: Mexico's federal government states it has the infrastructure to increase digital payments, with adoption rather than access being the main challenge, according to the financial regulator.

stories.title: Hacienda baja IEPS a gasolinas, mientras el diésel va por su tercera semana con cuota cero

en.title: Finance Ministry lowers gasoline tax, while diesel enters third week with zero levy
en.summary: For the week of September 26 to October 2, diesel used for mass transportation and freight movement will receive a 100% exemption on its fuel tax per liter.
